work_history.title: Data Scientist
work_history.description: Co-developed a winning proposal for a sign-language translation AI, securing a $50,000 grant (third of 91 international submissions) in an open beneficial-AI grant round. Worked fully remotely across multiple timezones. Built an end-to-end ML pipeline for ASL recognition: curated 24,000+ videos, implemented MediaPipe landmark extraction (543 points), and trained a Bidirectional LSTM achieving 91.85% weighted F1. Deployed a production AI service on the company's AI marketplace returning detected sign classes with confidence scores. Engineered a zero-retention privacy architecture with in-memory processing and immediate data discard post-inference.

work_history.title: Lead AI Engineer
work_history.description: Core AI engineer reporting to the CTO; curated a 15,000-item knowledge base for LLM grounding (+70% corpus relevance) and indexed it in Milvus with sub-30ms semantic search; designed a PostgreSQL schema for 2TB of application data. Fine-tuned open-source LLMs (LLaMA, Mistral, Qwen) with Unsloth; deployed via Docker and vLLM on on-prem H100 GPUs for 100+ concurrent requests on a platform with 2M users. Built CI/CD, Nginx load balancing and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring. Built multi-agent LLM chatbot microservices (FastAPI), cutting customer service response time from ~15 minutes to under 5 seconds.

work_history.title: Machine Learning Mentor
work_history.description: Mentored 25 students in ML; 2 graduated with distinction (top 10%). Holds TensorFlow Developer Certificate.

work_history.title: Data Scientist
work_history.description: Provided Rasa-based chatbot services used by government agencies and ministries. Created and maintained 20+ automation scripts for data scraping and transformation (SQL, Selenium, Beautiful Soup, Elasticsearch). Managed daily download and processing of 100+ GB of data. Deployed ML models as APIs using FastAPI.

work_history.title: Robotic Process Automation Developer Intern
work_history.description: Engineered an RPA bot using Automation Anywhere to automate operational tasks. Coordinated SIT, UAT and production acceptance testing. Completed automation equivalent to 0.89 FTE workload.
